description: ASQA ambiguous question with 3 gold sub-questions.

turns.utterance: Who is in charge of the hollywood walk of fame?

gold_sub_intents: Who administers the hollywood walk of fame?
Who maintains the hollywood walk of fame?
Who is in charge of choosing celebrities for the hollywood walk of fame?
gold_passages: Each year an average of 200 nominations are submitted to the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce Walk of Fame selection committee.
The Walk of Fame is administered by the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce and maintained by the self-financing Hollywood Historic Trust.
gold_answers: Hollywood Chamber of Commerce Walk of Fame selection committee
